From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: POC plan — success criteria and next steps

Hi Olivia / Raj —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Per our discovery call, I wanted to summarize next steps and propose a concrete POC plan so we can align on success criteria and ownership. Please review and call out anything you want to change.

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood inference for FinSys transactional summarization pipeline (latency, cost, fidelity to regulatory redaction rules).

Proposed POC (2 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): access + environment setup (service account, sample dataset upload)
- Week 1: run baseline tests (throughput, 95p latency, quality on 50 sample records)
- Week 2: iterate on prompt templates, enable KV caching, quantization profile, run final comparison vs current infra

Success criteria (proposed):
- 95th percentile end-to-end latency per request < 350ms for a 256-token request
- Token cost reduction >= 30% vs current endpoint (after batching/caching)
- Redaction accuracy >= 98% on regulated fields (measured on labeled sample)
- No PII leakage in logs (we will use private deployment options for the trial data)

Owners / contacts:
- FinSys: Olivia Chen (product) — validation, labeled samples; Raj Patel (infra) — network & access
- Redwood: Marissa Cole — POC lead; Aditya Rao — infra/ops owner; Dev Patel — prompt/quality support

Attachments: I attached a short POC plan and an editable success metrics spreadsheet.

Next steps:
1) Olivia to confirm the sample dataset and preferred environment (VPC vs hosted) by EOD Wed 3/25
2) Raj to provide an IP allowlist and a service account for sandbox by Fri 3/27
3) Redwood to provision sandbox and share credentials + run initial smoke test by Tue 3/31

If these look good I can convert into a mutual action plan in HubSpot and schedule a kickoff demo.

Thanks —
Marissa
